units.text: INT. FLOODED GRAIN SILO - NIGHT
Black water at chest height.
A single headlamp beam cuts the dust.
DMITRI VOLK, 40s, stocky, clings to a ladder rung.
He keeps the lamp.
KOFI ASANTE, 30s, lean, shivers beside him, one arm wrapped around a rusted pipe.
BRONWEN HALE, 50s, a farmer's hands, floats a plastic drum like a raft, its lid taped shut.
The water's still coming up.
units.name: DMITRI

units.text: It came up two rungs since the lamp was on my side.
units.name: KOFI

units.text: Then we climb.
units.name: BRONWEN

units.text: He said the hatch is sealed from outside.
units.name: DMITRI

units.text: Who did?
units.name: KOFI

units.text: You. Ten minutes ago.
units.name: DMITRI

units.text: I said I couldn't see the hatch. He was the one who saw it.
units.name: KOFI

units.text: Which he?
units.name: DMITRI

units.text: The man on the radio. Before it died.
units.name: KOFI

units.text: The radio man said the roof hatch opens inward. He said push, not pull.
units.name: BRONWEN

units.text: He also said an hour. That was three hours ago.
units.name: DMITRI

units.text: He didn't say that. He said maybe an hour. He was guessing.
units.name: KOFI

units.text: Both of you stop. Save the air.
units.name: BRONWEN

units.text: There's no air shortage. There's a hatch shortage.
units.name: DMITRI

units.text: Then give me the lamp and let me find it.
units.name: KOFI

units.text: You'll drop it.
units.name: DMITRI

units.text: I have not dropped a thing in my life.
units.name: KOFI

units.text: You dropped the radio.
units.name: BRONWEN

units.text: He dropped the radio. I only caught it badly.
units.name: KOFI

units.text: Fine. Take the lamp. But if he asks, I didn't hand it over.
units.name: DMITRI

units.text: Who is going to ask?
units.name: BRONWEN

units.text: Whoever finds us.
units.name: DMITRI

units.text: Water laps another rung.
Then we'd better be easy to find.
units.name: KOFI
